title: Soft landscaping for lots coded R100-SL: 10% of the site (Table 2.10a)
text: Table 2.10a Modified provisions for housing on lots less than 100m2. 1.2 Trees and landscaping | C1.2.1 C1.2.2 C1.2.4 | Landscaping - minimum of 10% of the site to be provided as soft landscaping, with a minimum dimension of 1m; and - no minimum landscaping of the street setback area. Trees - no minimum tree provisions

replaces.note: current R100-SL modification not confirmed from the register

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Table 2.10a: minimum 10% of the site as soft landscaping with a 1 m minimum dimension; no minimum landscaping of the street setback area (C1.2.2 excluded by coding) and no minimum tree provisions (C1.2.3 rules excluded by coding). Table 2.10a lists C1.2.4 in its clauses column; whether the tree-retention reduction is disapplied is unclear (moot at 10%). Two-column extract.
